verses.sloka: ततः समुत्थितः काल्यम् आस्थाय स्यन्दन उत्तमम् ।प्रययौ भरतः शीघ्रम् राम दर्शन कान्क्षया ॥२-८३-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samutthitaḥ kālyam āsthāya syandana uttamam ।prayayau bharataḥ śīghram rāma darśana kānkṣayā ॥2-83-1॥

translations.english: Getting up at dawn, Bharata boarded his excellent chariot and set forth swiftly, longing to see Rama.
translations.hindi: अयोध्याकाण्ड का उन्नीसीवाँ सग समाप्त हुआ । अशीतितमः सग; SN अथ भूमिप्रदेशज्ञाः घत्रकर्मविशारदा:! | २स्मकर्माभिरताः शूराः खनका यन्त्रकास्तथा

verses.sloka: अग्रतः प्रययुस् तस्य सर्वे मन्त्रि पुरोधसः ।अधिरुह्य हयैः युक्तान् रथान् सूर्य रथ उपमान् ॥२-८३-२॥
verses.transliteration: agrataḥ prayayus tasya sarve mantri purodhasaḥ ।adhiruhya hayaiḥ yuktān rathān sūrya ratha upamān ॥2-83-2॥

translations.english: All the ministers and priests went ahead of Bharata mounting their chariots, harnessed with horses and resembling the chariot of the Sun god.

verses.sloka: नव नाग सहस्राणि कल्पितानि यथा विधि ।अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दनम् ॥२-८३-३॥
verses.transliteration: nava nāga sahasrāṇi kalpitāni yathā vidhi ।anvayur bharatam yāntam ikṣvāku kula nandanam ॥2-83-3॥

translations.english: As per tradition, nine thousand elephants were arranged to follow Bharata, delight of the race of the Ikshvakus as he set out.

verses.sloka: षष्ठी रथ सहस्राणि धन्विनो विविध आयुधाः ।अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् राज पुत्रम् यशस्विनम् ॥२-८३-४॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhī ratha sahasrāṇi dhanvino vividha āyudhāḥ ।anvayur bharatam yāntam rāja putram yaśasvinam ॥2-83-4॥

translations.english: Sixty thousands chariots and many archers holding weapons of every kind followed the illustrious prince Bharata as he went.
translations.hindi: इन लोगों के. मुंड जो प्रसन्न होते हुए चले जति थे, ऐसे शोभायमान जान पड़ते थे, जैसे पूणमासी के दिन समुद्र शोभायमान देख पड़ता है । अर्थात, जैसे समुद्र उमडता है, वैसे ही मनुष्यों की भीड़ उमड़ो हुई जा रही थी

verses.sloka: शतम् सहस्राणि अश्वानाम् समारूढानि राघवम् ।अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् राज पुत्रम् यशस्विनम् ॥२-८३-५॥
verses.transliteration: śatam sahasrāṇi aśvānām samārūḍhāni rāghavam ।anvayur bharatam yāntam rāja putram yaśasvinam ॥2-83-5॥

translations.english: One hundred thousand horses each mounted by a rider followed Bharata, one who had conquered his passion and adhered to truth.

verses.sloka: कैकेयी च सुमित्रा च कौसल्या च यशस्विनी ।राम आनयन सम्हृष्टा ययुर् यानेन भास्वता ॥२-८३-६॥
verses.transliteration: kaikeyī ca sumitrā ca kausalyā ca yaśasvinī ।rāma ānayana samhṛṣṭā yayur yānena bhāsvatā ॥2-83-6॥

translations.english: Kaikeyi, Sumitra as well as the illustrious Kausalya travelled by a resplendent chariot, delighted with the thought of bringing Rama back.
translations.hindi: वे लोग रास्ता साफ करने के अभिप्राय से लता, बर्ली, भाड़, खू टी, पत्थर और अनेक प्रकार के वृत्तां को, जो रास्ते में पड़ते थे, काटकूट.कर, रास्ता बनाते जाते थे

verses.sloka: प्रयाताः च आर्य सम्घाता रामम् द्रष्टुम् सलक्ष्मणम् ।तस्य एव च कथाः चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्ट मानसाः ॥२-८३-७॥
verses.transliteration: prayātāḥ ca ārya samghātā rāmam draṣṭum salakṣmaṇam ।tasya eva ca kathāḥ citrāḥ kurvāṇā hṛṣṭa mānasāḥ ॥2-83-7॥

translations.english: Venerable people in groups, narrating various accomplishments of Rama and eager to see him with Lakshmana, proceeded in a delightful mood.

verses.sloka: मेघ श्यामम् महा बाहुम् स्थिर सत्त्वम् दृढ व्रतम् ।कदा द्रक्ष्यामहे रामम् जगतः शोक नाशनम् ॥२-८३-८॥
verses.transliteration: megha śyāmam mahā bāhum sthira sattvam dṛḍha vratam ।kadā drakṣyāmahe rāmam jagataḥ śoka nāśanam ॥2-83-8॥

translations.english: When shall we see that mightyarmed Rama of darkblue complexion like the raincloud, firm in strength and steadfast in vows and the destroyer of the sorrows of this world?
translations.hindi: इछ बलवान लागों ने अत्यन्त मजबूत टंठों को, जो उखाडे नहीं उखड्‌ सकते थे,जला कर साफ कर दिआ और जितने ऊँचे नीचे रास्ते और दुगम रथान थे, उन सब को ठोंक पीट तथा मिट्टी से पाट कर ठीक कर दिआ || <॥ दे अपरेऽपरयन्‌ कपान्‌ पासुभिः श्वश्रमायतम । निम्नमागांस्ततः केचित्समांश्चक्रः समन्तत;

verses.sloka: दृष्टएव हि नः शोकम् अपनेष्यति राघवः ।तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्न् इव भास्करः ॥२-८३-९॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaeva hi naḥ śokam apaneṣyati rāghavaḥ ।tamaḥ sarvasya lokasya samudyann iva bhāskaraḥ ॥2-83-9॥

translations.english: At his sight alone our sorrows will be dispelled, the way the darkness of the entire world is dispelled by the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: इति एवम् कथयन्तः ते सम्प्रहृष्टाः कथाः शुभाः ।परिष्वजानाः च अन्योन्यम् ययुर् नागरिकाः तदा ॥२-८३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam kathayantaḥ te samprahṛṣṭāḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ।pariṣvajānāḥ ca anyonyam yayur nāgarikāḥ tadā ॥2-83-10॥

translations.english: The inhabitants of the town proceeded joyfully, narrating Rama's delightful achievements on their way by embracing one another.
translations.hindi: कुछ लोग बीच रास्ते में जो कुएँ और गडहे आते उनको 'मिट्टी से पाटते और नीची भूमि को मिट्टी से भर, बरावर करते चले जाते थे ।।,& ॥ बवन्धुशबन्धनौयांश्च «षो दनीयांश्च चुक्नुदुःक । बिभिटुमदनी यांश्च तांस्तान्‌ देशान्‌ नरास्तदा

verses.sloka: ये च तत्र अपरे सर्वे सम्मता ये च नैगमाः ।रामम् प्रति ययुर् हृष्टाः सर्वाः प्रकृतयः तदा ॥२-८३-११॥
verses.transliteration: ye ca tatra apare sarve sammatā ye ca naigamāḥ ।rāmam prati yayur hṛṣṭāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayaḥ tadā ॥2-83-11॥

translations.english: Respectable city folks, like traders and other subjects went along in great delight towards Rama.

verses.sloka: मणि काराः च ये केचित् कुम्भ काराः च शोभनाः ।सूत्र कर्म कृतः चैव ये च शस्त्र उपजीविनः ॥२-८३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: maṇi kārāḥ ca ye kecit kumbha kārāḥ ca śobhanāḥ ।sūtra karma kṛtaḥ caiva ye ca śastra upajīvinaḥ ॥2-83-12॥

translations.english: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
translations.hindi: झौर जहाँ जल का अभांव था, वहाँ अनेक नए कुए' ओर तालाब खोदे और उनके समीप लोगों के विश्राम करने के लिए चबूतरे बना दिए

verses.sloka: मायूरकाः क्राकचिका रोचका वेधकाः तथा ।दन्त काराः सुधा काराः तथा गन्ध उपजीविनः ॥२-८३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: māyūrakāḥ krākacikā rocakā vedhakāḥ tathā ।danta kārāḥ sudhā kārāḥ tathā gandha upajīvinaḥ ॥2-83-13॥

translations.english: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
translations.hindi: उन शि््पियाँ ने सेना के जाने के रास्ते को चूने की गचों से ठीक कर, सड़क के इधर उधर ऐसे वृक्ष लगा दिए, जिन पर पक्षी बोला करते थे और. जगद जगह सड़कों के दोनों ओर पताकाएँ सुशोभित हो रही थीं

verses.sloka: सुवर्ण काराः प्रख्याताः तथा कम्बल धावकाः ।स्नापक आच्चादका वैद्या धूपकाः शौण्डिकाः तथा ॥२-८३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: suvarṇa kārāḥ prakhyātāḥ tathā kambala dhāvakāḥ ।snāpaka āccādakā vaidyā dhūpakāḥ śauṇḍikāḥ tathā ॥2-83-14॥

translations.english: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.
translations.hindi: चन्दन के जल क छिड़काव और अनेक प्रकार को फूली हुई लताओं से बह सेना का राता देवमाग की तरह सजा दिआ गया था

verses.sloka: रजकाः तुन्न वायाः च ग्राम घोष महत्तराः ।शैलूषाः च सह स्त्रीभिर् यान्ति कैवर्तकाः तथा ॥२-८३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: rajakāḥ tunna vāyāḥ ca grāma ghoṣa mahattarāḥ ।śailūṣāḥ ca saha strībhir yānti kaivartakāḥ tathā ॥2-83-15॥

translations.english: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.

verses.sloka: समाहिता वेदविदो ब्राह्मणा वृत्त सम्मताः ।गो रथैः भरतम् यान्तम् अनुजग्मुः सहस्रशः ॥२-८३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: samāhitā vedavido brāhmaṇā vṛtta sammatāḥ ।go rathaiḥ bharatam yāntam anujagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ ॥2-83-16॥

translations.english: Brahmins learned in the Vedas and renowned for their virtuous conduct followed Bharta in their thousands on bullock carts with composed minds.
translations.hindi: सेना के उतरने के लिए वैल ही स्थान बना दिए जैसे कि महात्मा भरत जी चाहते थे । फिर उन स्थानों को अनेक प्रकार की सामग्री से सजा भी दिया

verses.sloka: सुवेषाः शुद्ध वसनाः ताम्र मृष्ट अनुलेपनाः ।सर्वे ते विविधैः यानैः शनैः भरतम् अन्वयुः ॥२-८३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: suveṣāḥ śuddha vasanāḥ tāmra mṛṣṭa anulepanāḥ ।sarve te vividhaiḥ yānaiḥ śanaiḥ bharatam anvayuḥ ॥2-83-17॥

translations.english: Dressed well in clean clothes and anointed with pure red sandalpaste, they all slowly followed Bharata, mounting on various vehicles.

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्ट मुदिता सेना सान्वयात् कैकयी सुतम् ।भ्रातुरानयने यान्तम् भरतम् भ्रातृवत्सलम् ॥२-८३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭa muditā senā sānvayāt kaikayī sutam ।bhrāturānayane yāntam bharatam bhrātṛvatsalam ॥2-83-18॥

translations.english: The army, overwhelmed with joy and cheer followed the devoted brother Bharata who had set out to bring back Rama.
translations.hindi: शिबिर, इन्द्रनील पवत कॉ तरह ऊचे रेतीले घुस्सों से तथा वलयुक्त खाइयाँ से घिरवा दिए गए थे और जगह जगह रास्ते बना दिए गए थे

verses.sloka: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानम् रथम् यानाश्वकुञ्जरैः ।समासेदुस्ततो गङ्गाम् शृङ्गिबेरपुरम् प्रति ॥२-८३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: te gatvā dūramadhvānam ratham yānāśvakuñjaraiḥ ।samāsedustato gaṅgām śṛṅgiberapuram prati ॥2-83-19॥

translations.english: After travelling a long distance on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, they reached the river Ganga close to Srngiberapura, a country ruled vigilantly by Rama's friend, the valiant Guha who lived there along with his relatives.

verses.sloka: यत्र रामसखो वीरो गुहो ज्ञातिगणैर्वृतः ।निवसत्यप्रमादेन देशम् तम् परिपालयन् ॥२-८३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: yatra rāmasakho vīro guho jñātigaṇairvṛtaḥ ।nivasatyapramādena deśam tam paripālayan ॥2-83-20॥

translations.english: After travelling a long distance on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, they reached the river Ganga close to Srngiberapura, a country ruled vigilantly by Rama's friend, the valiant Guha who lived there along with his relatives.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर सतखने गुदो के ऊपर जो अटारियाँ थीं, वे कवूतरों के बैठने की छतरी का तरह ऊँची थीं । ऊँचे ऊँचे भवनों को देखने से ऐसा जान पा था, मानों आकाश में देवताओं के आवासस्थान बने हों | उस समय उन पड़ावों की शोभा इन्द्र को अमरावती पुरी की शोभा जैसी हो रही थी

verses.sloka: उपेत्य तीरम् गङ्गायाश्चक्रमाकैरलङ्कतम् ।व्यवतिष्ठत सा सेना भरतस्य अनुयायिनी ॥२-८३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: upetya tīram gaṅgāyāścakramākairalaṅkatam ।vyavatiṣṭhata sā senā bharatasya anuyāyinī ॥2-83-21॥

translations.english: The army following Bharata reached the bank of the river Ganga, graced by chakravakas (ruddy geese) and halted there.
translations.hindi: भरत जी के लिए, ( अयोध्या से लेकर) निमंल एब शीतल जल वाली उस गङ्गा तक, जिसमें वडी बड़ी मछलियाँ रहती हैं, जो माग बनाया गया था, उसके अगल बगल तरह तरह के वृक्षों से युक्त अनेक कानन थे । अर्थात्‌ यह मार्ग जङ्गलो में हो कर गया था

verses.sloka: निरीक्ष्य अनुगताम् सेनाम् ताम् च गन्गाम् शिव उदकाम् ।भरतः सचिवान् सर्वान् अब्रवीद् वाक्य कोविदः ॥२-८३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya anugatām senām tām ca gangām śiva udakām ।bharataḥ sacivān sarvān abravīd vākya kovidaḥ ॥2-83-22॥

translations.english: As he beheld the army following him and the river Ganga of sacred waters in front of him, Bharata who was proficient in speech said to his ministers:

verses.sloka: निवेशयत मे सैन्यम् अभिप्रायेण सर्वशः ।विश्रान्तः प्रतरिष्यामः श्वैदानीम् महा नदीम् ॥२-८३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: niveśayata me sainyam abhiprāyeṇa sarvaśaḥ ।viśrāntaḥ pratariṣyāmaḥ śvaidānīm mahā nadīm ॥2-83-23॥

translations.english: You may, according to your convenience, halt the army anywhere here and, after taking rest (for the night), we shall cross the river Ganga tomorrow.

verses.sloka: दातुम् च तावद् इच्चामि स्वर् गतस्य मही पतेः ।और्ध्वदेह निमित्त अर्थम् अवतीर्य उदकम् नदीम् ॥२-८३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: dātum ca tāvad iccāmi svar gatasya mahī pateḥ ।aurdhvadeha nimitta artham avatīrya udakam nadīm ॥2-83-24॥

translations.english: Meanwhile, I shall get into this river and offer libations with water to the departed king for the good of his life in the other world.

verses.sloka: तस्य एवम् ब्रुवतः अमात्याः तथा इति उक्त्वा समाहिताः ।न्यवेशयम्स् तामः चन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक् पृथक् ॥२-८३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya evam bruvataḥ amātyāḥ tathā iti uktvā samāhitāḥ ।nyaveśayams tāmaḥ candena svena svena pṛthak pṛthak ॥2-83-25॥

translations.english: While he (Bharata's) was speaking this way, all the ministers assented by saying 'Be it so' and made arrangement for their troops to rest separately according to their pleasure.

verses.sloka: निवेश्य गन्गाम् अनु ताम् महा नदीम् ।चमूम् विधानैः परिबर्ह शोभिनीम् ।उवास रामस्य तदा महात्मनो ।विचिन्तयानो भरतः निवर्तनम् ॥२-८३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: niveśya gangām anu tām mahā nadīm ।camūm vidhānaiḥ paribarha śobhinīm ।uvāsa rāmasya tadā mahātmano ।vicintayāno bharataḥ nivartanam ॥2-83-26॥

translations.english: The army encamped by Bharata looked splendid with royal insigaia. After making necessary arrangements for the army on the bank of the mighty river Ganga and pondering over the means of bringing back the magnanimous Rama, Bharata stayed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
